findings.title: Lock-up restrictions on marketable equity securities not reflected in net cash judgment
findings.detail: Net cash (66,003M) includes marketable equity securities of 42,783M at full balance-sheet fair value. Note 5 of the 10-Q (snapshot/docs/periodic.txt, footnote (1) to the Jul 26, 2026 table) states that $36.9B of publicly-held equity investments are subject to short-term lock-up restrictions on the ability to sell, and $10.8B are Level 2 (unregistered warrants and convertible preferred). The mapping rationale says 'the valuation step may haircut them', but valuation_inputs.json applies no haircut and its rationales do not discuss it. note.md mentions price volatility but not the lock-up or Level 2 composition. Impact is small: a full exclusion lowers the blended target by roughly $1.2/share and keeps the rating Underperform, so the conclusion does not change. It should still be disclosed.
findings.required_evidence: note.md net-cash judgment (or valuation_inputs rationale) mentions that about $36.9B of marketable equity is under short-term lock-up and states whether a haircut is applied

findings.title: Peer calendar label inconsistent with peer TTM end dates
findings.detail: peers.json labels every peer 'calendar': 'CY2025Q4', but the ttm_end dates are 2026-06-27 (AMD), 2026-05-03 (AVGO) and 2026-05-02 (MRVL), i.e. CY2026Q2 or late CY2026Q1/early Q2. NVIDIA's TTM ends 2026-07-26 (CY2026Q2). note.md already says correctly that peer TTM periods end one to three months before NVIDIA's quarter end, so the prose is right and only the code label looks wrong. Raised for the code/lead to check; no candidate change required for the conclusion.
findings.required_evidence: peers.json calendar label consistent with ttm_end, or the label is not used in the note
